economic_thesis: Coin-specific relative strength or weakness that agrees across 21-, 63-, and 126-bar horizons can persist through the next week; volatility scaling, horizon-agreement shrinkage, median residualization, and exact neutrality isolate that persistence from common crypto direction and transient shocks.
falsifier: Reject if the exact no-control core misses net Sharpe 0.75, positive annualized return, Calmar 0.40, drawdown at most 0.30, doubled-cost Sharpe 0.35 and positive return, trial-adjusted probability 0.90, four profitable folds, positive-quarter fraction 0.55, worst-regime Sharpe -0.25, three positive regime Sharpes, positive bull/bear/chop return and Sharpe, positive long-bull/short-bear/combined-chop attribution, either sleeve floor (0.01 exposure, 0.10 active fraction, 0.01 mean exposure, 1000 USDT notional), concentration 0.40, complete A5 coverage, positive pooled IC, or four positive fold ICs. After those non-neighborhood gates pass, require 0.70 profitable neighbors and median neighbor Sharpe 0.50. Controls, neighbors, ablations, private data, and sign inversion cannot rescue failure.
mechanism: Weekly per-bar median residualization; volatility-scaled 21/63/126-bar continuation; two-of-three horizon agreement with disagreement and recent-volatility shrinkage; one final A5 rank; broad equal-dollar 0.36-gross exact-neutral book.
risk_policy_plan: Exact disabled no-control core first; declared neighbors only after its non-neighborhood pass; controls/private/submission only after the full pass.
